dedupe_keys.name: world bank commodity price data pink sheet

description: The Pink Sheet is the World Bank's monthly release of commodity prices, with historical monthly and annual price series and price indices for energy, food, beverages, agricultural raw materials, fertilisers, and base and precious metals and minerals. It is produced by the World Bank Prospects Group, which also publishes the Commodity Markets Outlook with price forecasts; the April 2026 Outlook expected overall commodity prices to rise 16% in 2026. Coverage is global benchmark prices, monthly and annual, over several decades; the page read showed a September 2026 update and the next Outlook due in October 2026. Data come as Excel files, with the Outlook and forecast tables as PDF, free and without registration under the World Bank terms of use for datasets, listed as CC BY 4.0 in its data catalogue. Caveats: prices are nominal benchmark quotations for specific markets and grades, so local prices and transport costs differ, and forecasts are revised each Outlook. For simulation it provides price shocks and scenario inputs for economic models of mining, agriculture and energy supply chains, and for resilience analyses of how commodity price spikes spread to infrastructure costs. It is related to the WITS record in this catalogue, which gives the trade flows of the same commodities.
